allowed_claims: A deterministic synthetic weather/NFZ engineering environment with bounded contract evidence.
Exactness and causal-frontier claims within the explicitly declared finite-domain model.
A reproducible emergency event simulator with 120 smoke rows, 13 boundary cases, finite-horizon phase-accounting, and fixed-station action-domain witnesses.

bounded_theorem_contracts.claim: Piecewise-constant wind straight-leg integration is exact under the declared fixed-airspeed model.
bounded_theorem_contracts.scope: finite knots, no waiting, one straight segment at a time

bounded_theorem_contracts.claim: The visibility search is finite and deterministic under the no-wait/no-cycle simple-path contract.
bounded_theorem_contracts.scope: endpoint plus convex-NFZ-vertex graph; stable (arrival, distance, path) tie-break

bounded_theorem_contracts.claim: Strict-interior NFZ overlap is rejected only when the integrated time interval overlaps the half-open active interval.
bounded_theorem_contracts.scope: convex polygon, boundary/tangent legs legal, active interval [on, off)

bounded_theorem_contracts.claim: Weather observations expose only the declared causal frontier and the independent replay checks terminal route admissibility.
bounded_theorem_contracts.scope: fixed outer station/ownership contract; no claim of generalization

bounded_theorem_contracts.claim: Emergency events have deterministic ordering and account only the executed finite-horizon position, energy, duty, and cost prefix.
bounded_theorem_contracts.scope: finite drones/tasks, bounded waits, declared piecewise-constant trace, terminal failure stops a drone

bounded_theorem_contracts.claim: Emergency rates use an explicit fixed denominator, including a null zero-emergency denominator.
bounded_theorem_contracts.scope: multiple emergency tasks, exact deadline, late delivery, zero-emergency case

bounded_theorem_contracts.claim: Fixed station ownership is preserved by the ranking baselines, and action masks exclude busy, terminal, horizon, and invalid-index actions.
bounded_theorem_contracts.scope: 2-4 fixed stations, normal/reversed task order, three baselines; bounded event model

interpretation: Engineering PASS is evidence of implementation integrity only. The current state does not support a positive RL, novelty, generalization, or flight-safety conclusion.
prohibited_claims: RL superiority over the author solution or strongest same-objective non-RL control.
Distinct algorithmic novelty or a new metric novelty claim.
Real-weather calibration, confirmation-set statistical power, or real-flight safety.
A completed manuscript or G7/G8 publication readiness.
required_next_scientific_gate: Register a distinct non-rescue protocol with fixed train/validation populations, at least three independent seeds, author and strongest same-objective non-RL controls, complete-candidate accounting, and predeclared statistical analysis before any new run.

blockers.reason: No complete candidate and no demonstrated improvement over author and strongest same-objective non-RL control.
